artifacts.summary: 4-phase sequential plan for the narrow catch-up sync of .opencode/scripts/command-gate-in.sh: capture pre-change run-all.sh baselines in both source-store and deployed modes; verbatim cp of the already-correct agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/command-gate-in.sh into the stale .opencode/ target with byte-identity, exec-bit, bash -n, and task-reference-lint verification; a full verification gate re-running both suites and diffing FAIL sets against the baseline (deployed must lose exactly test-common-lib.sh and gain nothing); and a record phase capturing the manual-redeploy rationale plus the two out-of-scope spawn candidates. No source-store edit is planned -- the source file is already correct.
